design: Monte Carlo simulation, 4000 replications, equal means, n=10 (sd 3) vs n=40 (sd 1).

statistical_tests.hypothesis: Student and Welch reject at different rates
Welch rejects at the nominal rate
statistical_tests.test: one-sample z test for a proportion

sample_size_justification: 4000 replications give a Wilson half-width under 1.5 percentage points at rates near 25%.
